levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Entries mix in judgment words (good, bad, lazy, greedy) or any weight/size/calorie language.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All four entries use only the five neutral signal words with no judgment or body-size language.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Neutral throughout, and the reflection explicitly notices when a judgment thought showed up and sets it aside.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Clue described does not clearly match the signal named.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Each clue plausibly matches its named signal.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Clues are specific and personal rather than generic restatements of the signal word.

lookFors: No weight, size, calorie, or body-shape word appears anywhere in the four entries.
Four separate moments are recorded, not one moment repeated.
The reflection names a specific signal, not a vague 'today was hard.'

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
